author.method: Direção autorada a partir das correções do usuário; tempos do exemplo são propostas, sem geração externa ou aprovação audiovisual.

locations.description: A quiet warm cafe with soft window light and a wooden table.
A calm street outside the cafe, with open space in the walking direction.
A clean studio with a muted blue background and enough space for both arms.

shots.purpose: Introduce the performer and motivate the move outside.
shots.subject: A fictional adult performer with short dark curls, wearing a plain cobalt jacket over a white shirt; keep the same face, proportions and wardrobe across all shots.
shots.performance: Natural tempo, continuous breathing and coherent hands, shoulders and eye line. Do not render the portal, its glow, captions or transition effect into this base performance.
shots.lighting: Soft, stable lighting motivated by the stated environment; preserve facial identity.

camera.purpose: Keep the action, hands and body proportions readable.
camera.movement: Hold an eye-level medium shot; no zoom.

actions.description: Already visible from the first frame, hold a closed notebook at waist level and breathe naturally.
Lift the gaze from the notebook toward the exit on screen right.
Begin turning shoulders toward screen right; keep the movement readable for the cut.

9:16.framing: Medium shot from waist to above the head; keep both hands and the notebook inside the narrow frame.
9:16.rationale: Compose the action for portrait instead of cropping a landscape performance.

16:9.framing: Medium-wide shot with the performer on the left third and the cafe exit visible on the right.
16:9.rationale: Use horizontal room for the environment and action without stretching the person.

shots.purpose: Continue the same screen direction and prepare a hand gesture.
shots.subject: A fictional adult performer with short dark curls, wearing a plain cobalt jacket over a white shirt; keep the same face, proportions and wardrobe across all shots.
shots.performance: Natural tempo, continuous breathing and coherent hands, shoulders and eye line. Do not render the portal, its glow, captions or transition effect into this base performance.
shots.lighting: Soft, stable lighting motivated by the stated environment; preserve facial identity.

camera.purpose: Keep the action, hands and body proportions readable.
camera.movement: Track gently alongside the performer, then settle when the performer stops.

actions.description: Continue toward screen right with two unhurried steps; keep the notebook in the left hand.
Stop, turn the torso toward the camera and raise the free right hand.
Hold the open right palm at chest height, with small natural motion; prepare a match cut.

9:16.framing: Leave headroom and lower-frame room for steps; both forearms stay inside the portrait canvas.
9:16.rationale: Compose the action for portrait instead of cropping a landscape performance.

16:9.framing: Leave lead room to screen right and keep the walking path and both arms visible.
16:9.rationale: Use horizontal room for the environment and action without stretching the person.

shots.purpose: Provide a complete new performance on which the portal can be composed later.
shots.subject: A fictional adult performer with short dark curls, wearing a plain cobalt jacket over a white shirt; keep the same face, proportions and wardrobe across all shots.
shots.performance: Natural tempo, continuous breathing and coherent hands, shoulders and eye line. Do not render the portal, its glow, captions or transition effect into this base performance.
shots.lighting: Soft, stable lighting motivated by the stated environment; preserve facial identity.

camera.purpose: Keep the action, hands and body proportions readable.
camera.movement: Use a locked eye-level camera at a distance that contains the entire gesture; no push-in.

actions.description: Start with the right palm at the same height and facing the same direction as the prior shot.
Bring both hands up and separate them gradually to outline an opening; retain natural wrist and shoulder movement.
Sustain the open gesture, with the face, both shoulders and forearms visible.
Settle the gesture into a stable closing pose, without freezing the performer.

9:16.framing: Medium shot from waist upward with generous lateral room for both hands; avoid an oversized face and shoulders.
9:16.rationale: Compose the action for portrait instead of cropping a landscape performance.

16:9.framing: Medium-wide shot with the performer near center and room on both sides for the opening gesture.
16:9.rationale: Use horizontal room for the environment and action without stretching the person.

joins.rationale: Change location while preserving rightward screen direction.
joins.incoming: The same performer continues screen right outdoors.

joins.rationale: Join the environments through a matching right-hand pose.
joins.outgoing: Right palm open at chest height.
joins.incoming: Right palm at the same position and orientation in the studio.
